Tamil Nadu CM to meet Andhra Pradesh CM over Krishna water dispute

Tamil Nadu Chief Minister M.K. Stalin is scheduled to meet Andhra Pradesh Chief Minister Y.S. Jagan Mohan Reddy in Vijayawada on Tuesday to discuss the shortfall of Krishna river water to Tamil Nadu. The meeting aims to seek additional water from Andhra Pradesh.
